purpose: Require immutable competitor identities, matched semantics, and reproducible build recipes before comparative measurements are promoted.

competitors.name: RisGraph
competitors.notes: Primary external dynamic-algorithm baseline. Timing is emitted only after initial/final BFS layer equivalence and VeloGraphX full-recompute validation pass.

competitors.name: Teseo
competitors.comparison_scope: future storage-only update and adjacency-scan comparison; excluded from incremental-algorithm speedup tables
competitors.notes: The public Teseo API is a transactional dynamic graph store, not a same-semantics incremental BFS maintainer. It is retained as a storage candidate only.

competitors.name: NetworkX
competitors.comparison_scope: reference/ergonomics only unless an exact matched workload is defined

competitors.name: python-igraph
competitors.comparison_scope: static/native-backed reference only unless an exact matched dynamic workload is defined

competitors.name: NetworKit
competitors.comparison_scope: static/native-backed reference only unless an exact matched dynamic workload is defined

competitors.name: rustworkx
competitors.comparison_scope: static/native-backed reference only unless an exact matched dynamic workload is defined

competitors.name: SuiteSparse:GraphBLAS/LAGraph
competitors.comparison_scope: static algorithm reference unless a matched dynamic contract is defined

rules: Do not use floating labels such as latest, main, master or HEAD as publication pins.
Native competitors must record an immutable commit SHA or release tag plus compiler/build options.
A competitor may be marked ready only after its pinned identity and matched comparison scope are captured by the benchmark contract.
Algorithm-maintenance timing requires the same algorithm result and update semantics on both systems.
Storage-only systems must not be presented in algorithm-maintenance speedup tables.
Correctness/equivalence gates must pass before any timing ratio is promoted.
Hosted CI comparative measurements are engineering evidence, not universal or publication-grade performance claims.
notes: RisGraph is the first ready same-semantics dynamic algorithm baseline. Teseo is intentionally scoped to future storage-only evidence to avoid an unfair algorithm-vs-storage comparison.
